tasks.notes: Documented the dual-write map load path in LoadMapsAsync/BuildMapsUrl and recorded that export should hang off the existing toolbar after records are loaded, with a new SaveFileDialog-based boundary because the repo has no existing save-file picker abstraction.
acceptance: The code path that loads dual-write maps is identified.

Do not implement export logic in this task.

tasks.title: Implement markdown serialization for one dual-write map
tasks.notes: Separating serialization from selection and file I/O keeps the feature testable and reusable.
acceptance: A dedicated exporter produces a .md document for a single dual-write map.
The markdown includes all currently available mapping information exposed by the source model.
Missing optional fields are rendered predictably without throwing exceptions.
constraints: Limit scope to formatting one map into markdown.
Do not add multi-select or file save UI in this task.

tasks.title: Add multi-map export workflow
acceptance: Users can select multiple dual-write maps in one action.
The export workflow generates one .md file per selected map.
The feature leaves existing single-map behaviors unchanged unless explicitly extended.
constraints: Reuse existing selection patterns where available.
Do not bundle files into archives unless the codebase already does so.

tasks.title: Add user-chosen save destination handling
acceptance: The export flow prompts for a destination chosen by the user.
Generated .md files are written to the selected location with safe file names.
Errors for invalid or unwritable destinations are surfaced in the app's existing error pattern.
constraints: Do not introduce silent fallback paths.
Do not overwrite files without following existing app conventions.

tasks.title: Cover markdown export with focused tests
acceptance: Tests verify markdown output contains all expected mapping fields.
Tests verify multiple selected maps produce multiple files or file-write requests.
Tests cover at least one failure path for destination or file creation.
constraints: Add only targeted tests for the new export feature.
